notes: Stories defined for Clinical Trial Snapshot feature.

stories.title: Clinical Trial Snapshot Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the canonical trial snapshot schema including phase, status, summary, eligibility criteria, locations, and URL. Establish response contract between domain service and facade.

stories.title: Clinical Trial Data Extraction and Mapping Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to extract and normalize trial attributes (phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, URL) from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses into the defined schema.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Trial Snapshot
stories.description: Integrate trial snapshot output into EvaluateCare facade, ensuring structured delivery to the chat layer and compatibility with existing tool routing.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Clinical Trial Snapshot
stories.description: Render trial snapshot attributes in chat UI including structured display of phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, and clickable URL with safe formatting.

stories.title: Clinical Trial Snapshot Tests and Integration Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema compliance, field extraction accuracy, facade integration, and UI rendering of trial snapshots.
